quest.j: Beautiful spelling — you are on a roll!

quest.q: Mina wrote a card to her best ___. Which spelling is right?
quest.c: Friend has “ie” — “I am your friend till the end!”
quest.j: A friend in need is a friend indeed!

quest.q: Choose the correct spelling of the word that means “from one side to the other”.
quest.c: Through has “ough” — the tricky part hides in the middle.
quest.j: You made it through — nicely done!

quest.q: Which sentence has every word spelt correctly?
o: I like ice-cream becouse it is sweet.
I like icecream because it is swete.
I like icecream becoz it is sweet.
I like ice cream because it is sweet.
quest.c: Because is b-e-c-a-u-s-e. Try: “big elephants can always understand small elephants”!

quest.q: Pick the word that is spelt right.
quest.c: Together is to-get-her — three little parts in one word.

warm.q: The baby is crying ___. Which spelling is right?
All the ___ in the class love story time.
Many ___ visit the library every day.
You ___ wash your hands before lunch.
I ___ it was going to rain, so I took an umbrella.
We have ___ food for everyone at the party.
What is the ___ to this question?
Please wash your hands ___ you eat.

fresh.q: The police ___ the thief yesterday.
fresh.c: Caught is the past of catch — “a-u-g-h-t”!
fresh.j: Caught red-handed — and correctly spelt!

fresh.q: My ___ loves to bake chocolate cakes.
fresh.c: Daughter has “ugh” in the middle — “d-a-u-g-h-t-e-r”.
fresh.j: A daughter who bakes? Lucky family!

fresh.q: We wake up ___ every school morning.
fresh.c: Early is e-a-r-l-y — like “ear” at the start!
fresh.j: Early bird, early speller!

fresh.q: There are ___ legs on a spider.
fresh.c: Eight is e-i-g-h-t — the “gh” is silent but it is there!
fresh.j: Eight legs, one great spelling!

fresh.q: What is your ___ colour?
fresh.c: Favourite is f-a-v-o-u-r-i-t-e — remember the “u”!
fresh.j: My favourite colour is… correctly spelt!

fresh.q: Grandma grows tomatoes in her ___.
fresh.c: Garden is g-a-r-d-e-n — “den” at the end, like a little den!
fresh.j: A garden full of good spelling!

fresh.q: Our class went on a ___ to the museum.
fresh.c: Journey is j-o-u-r-n-e-y — “our” is hiding inside it!
fresh.j: What a journey — and what spelling!

fresh.q: Please ___ carefully to the teacher.
fresh.c: Listen has a silent “t” — “lis-ten”!
fresh.j: I am all ears — and all correct!

fresh.q: We climbed a tall ___ on our school trip.
fresh.c: Mountain is m-o-u-n-t-a-i-n — “tain” at the end!
fresh.j: On top of the mountain — and top of the class!

fresh.q: How ___ do you visit your grandma?
fresh.c: Often is o-f-t-e-n — the “t” is quiet, like a secret!
fresh.j: Often right — that is the best kind!

retry.q: May I have a ___ of cake, please?
retry.c: Piece has “ie” — “a piece of pie” helps you remember!
retry.j: A piece of cake — and a piece of great spelling!

retry.q: ___ sit down and open your books.
retry.c: Please is p-l-e-a-s-e — “please” is a please-ant word!

retry.q: She wore a ___ dress to the party.
retry.c: Pretty is p-r-e-t-t-y — double “t” makes it pretty!

retry.j: School’s cool — and so is your spelling!

retry.q: Draw a ___ line with your ruler.
retry.c: Straight is s-t-r-a-i-g-h-t — “aight” at the end, like “eight”!
Weather is w-e-a-t-h-e-r — “eat” is hiding in the middle!
retry.j: Whatever the weather, your spelling shines!

p4quest.q: He ___ dropped his ice cream on the floor.
p4quest.c: Accidentally ends in “ally” — accidents happen, but spelling should not!
p4quest.j: An accidental drop, but no accidental spelling!

p4quest.q: Please write your home ___ on the form.
p4quest.c: Address has double “d” and double “s” — a double-double!
p4quest.j: You have got the address — and the spelling!

p4quest.q: I ___ you can do it if you keep trying.

p4quest.c: Bicycle is b-i-c-y-c-l-e — “bi” means two wheels!

p4quest.q: Check the ___ to see what day it is.
p4quest.j: Mark this day on the calendar — you spelt it right!

p4warm.q: The shopping ___ is in the middle of town.
I am ___ that the show starts at 7pm.
Can you ___ your favourite animal to me?
I love ice cream, ___ chocolate flavour.
My birthday is in ___, the shortest month.
Please move ___ so we can see the board.

p4fresh.q: The ___ keeps the school safe at night.
p4fresh.c: Guard is g-u-a-r-d — the “u” stands guard too!
p4fresh.j: On guard — and on point with spelling!

p4fresh.q: What is the ___ of that tall building?
p4fresh.c: Height is h-e-i-g-h-t — “ei” after “h”!

p4fresh.q: Singapore is an ___.
p4fresh.c: Island has a silent “s” — “is-land”!

p4fresh.q: Reading books gives you ___.
p4fresh.c: Knowledge ends in “dge” — “know” + “ledge”!
p4fresh.j: Knowledge is power — and so is spelling!

p4fresh.q: We borrow books from the ___.
p4fresh.c: Library is l-i-b-r-a-r-y — “brary” like “January”!
p4fresh.j: Shh… your spelling is library-quiet and perfect!

p4fresh.q: The ___ puppy chewed my shoes!
p4fresh.c: Naughty is n-a-u-g-h-t-y — “augh” makes the “or” sound!

p4fresh.q: Our ___ bakes the best cookies.
p4fresh.c: Neighbour is n-e-i-g-h-b-o-u-r — “neigh” like a horse!

p4fresh.q: What a special ___ — a birthday party!
p4fresh.c: Occasion has double “c” and single “s” — “oc-ca-sion”!

p4fresh.q: North is the ___ of south.
p4fresh.c: Opposite has double “p” — “op-po-site”!

p4fresh.q: A camera is a useful ___ on holiday.
p4fresh.c: Possession has double “s” twice — “pos-ses-sion”!

p4retry.q: I will ___ finish my homework tonight.
Please ___ the two words with a line.
p4retry.c: Separate has “a” in the middle — “there is a rat in separate”!
p4retry.j: Separate the right from the wrong — done!

p4retry.q: What a nice ___ — a new puppy!
We will go to the zoo ___.
p4retry.j: Tomorrow is another day — and another win!

p4retry.q: Take an ___ in case it rains.
p4retry.j: Rain or shine, your spelling is fine!

p4retry.q: ___ is the middle of the school week.
p4retry.j: Hump day? More like champ day!

newTopics.name: Visual Text Detectives
newTopics.blurb: Posters and notices — what are they really saying?

quest.q:
Read this poster:

🌊 BEACH CLEAN-UP!
Join us this Saturday at East Coast Park, 8am–11am. Gloves and bags provided. Let’s keep our beach clean!

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To warn people not to swim in the sea
To teach people how to surf
To ask people to help clean the beach
To sell tickets to a beach party
quest.c: The poster asks people to join in and help — that is what it is for.

quest.q:
Read this poster:

📚 BIG BOOK FAIR!
Our school library is holding a book fair! Monday to Friday, 9am–4pm. Hundreds of books at low prices. Come and find your next favourite story!

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To ask children to return their library books
To sell library cards to parents
To teach children how to read
To tell families about a book fair at the library
quest.c: The poster tells people about the fair so they will come.
quest.j: A book fair — every page a new adventure!

quest.q:
Read this notice:

LOST CAT! 🐱
Our orange cat, Milo, is missing. He was last seen near Block 12, Hougang Avenue 3. He is friendly and loves treats. Please call 9123 4567 if you see him.

What colour is the lost cat?
quest.c: The notice says Milo is an orange cat.

quest.q:
Read this poster:

🎵 SCHOOL CONCERT!
Come and enjoy an evening of music! Friday, 7pm, School Hall. Tickets: $5 for adults, free for children under 12.

What time does the concert start?
quest.c: The poster says the concert starts at 7pm.
quest.j: Music to my ears — and a correct answer!

quest.q:
Read this poster:

🍦 FREE ICE CREAM!
Come to Sunny’s Ice Cream Shop this Sunday! Free ice cream for the first 50 children. One scoop each. While stocks last!

Who can get a free ice cream?
quest.c: Only the first 50 children get one — after that, the free scoops are gone!

warm.q:
Read this poster:

♻️ RECYCLING DRIVE!
Bring your old newspapers and cans to the Community Centre this weekend. Help us turn trash into treasure!

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To sell newspapers at the Community Centre
To teach people to make treasure
To ask people to clean the Community Centre
To ask people to bring old newspapers and cans

warm.q:
Read this notice:

⚠️ SWIMMING POOL RULES
No running by the pool. No diving in the shallow end. Children must be with an adult.

What is the main purpose of this notice?
o: To tell swimmers the pool rules
To ask people to build a pool

warm.q:
Read this poster:

🎨 ART COMPETITION!
Draw your favourite animal! Entries close Friday. Open to children aged 7 to 12. Prizes for the top 3 drawings.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To ask children to buy art paper
To ask children to join an art competition
To teach children to draw animals

warm.q:
Read this poster:

🧁 BAKE SALE!
Saturday, 10am–2pm, School Canteen. Cakes, cookies and muffins — all $2 each. All money goes to the school library fund.

How much does each cake cost?

Read this notice:

🚌 BUS 87 — NEW TIMETABLE
From Monday, Bus 87 leaves Hougang Interchange every 15 minutes, from 6am to 11pm.

How often does Bus 87 leave?

Read this poster:

🍎 FRUIT STALL!
Fresh mangoes $3 each. Buy 3 for $8! Open daily, 8am–6pm, at the wet market.

How much do 3 mangoes cost?

Read this poster:

🎁 TOY DONATION!
Give your old toys a new home! Toys must be clean and in working order. Drop them off at the library by Sunday.

Which toy can be donated?
o: A clean teddy bear that still works
A broken toy car with missing wheels
A dirty doll with no arms

warm.q:
Read this poster:

⛸️ ICE SKATING RINK!
Open daily, 10am–10pm. Skates for rent: $8. Socks are required — no bare feet on the ice!

What must you wear on the ice?

fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🐶 PET ADOPTION DAY!
Meet our furry friends looking for a home! Saturday, 11am–4pm, Animal Shelter. All pets are vaccinated and ready to meet you!

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To sell pet food at the shelter
To ask people to bring their pets to the shelter
To ask people to come and adopt a pet
fresh.c: The poster invites people to meet pets that need homes.
fresh.j: A new best friend is waiting for you!

fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🌱 GARDEN OPEN DAY!
Visit our beautiful community garden! Sunday, 9am–12pm. See vegetables, flowers and herbs growing. Free entry for all!

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To invite people to visit the community garden
To sell vegetables from the garden
To ask people to plant a garden
To teach people to water plants
fresh.c: The poster invites everyone to come and visit the garden.
fresh.j: Come smell the flowers — and the correct answer!

fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🚶 CHARITY WALK!
Walk 5km for a good cause! Sunday, 7am, East Coast Park. Sign up at the Community Centre. Every step helps children in need.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To ask people to run at the park
To ask people to join a charity walk
fresh.c: The poster asks people to sign up and walk for charity.
fresh.j: Every step counts — and so does this answer!

fresh.q:
Read this poster:

📖 READING CHALLENGE!
Read 5 books this month and win a prize! Collect your reading card from the library. Challenge ends 30 June.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To teach children to write books
To ask children to return library books
To ask children to read 5 books and win a prize
To sell reading cards at the library
fresh.c: The poster challenges children to read five books for a prize.
fresh.j: Five books, one prize, one great answer!

fresh.q:
Read this poster:

⚽ FOOTBALL TRIALS!
Want to join our school football team? Trials on Tuesday, 4pm, School Field. Bring sports shoes and a water bottle. All Primary 3 pupils welcome!

Who can join the trials?
o: Only pupils with their own ball
fresh.c: The poster says all Primary 3 pupils are welcome.
fresh.j: Goal! You scored a correct answer!

fresh.q:
Read this notice:

📦 LOST AND FOUND
Found: a blue water bottle, a red umbrella and a black wallet. Please collect your items from the General Office by Friday.

Where can you collect lost items?
fresh.c: The notice says to collect items from the General Office.
fresh.j: Found it! Great detective work!

fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🎬 MOVIE NIGHT!
“Adventures of Pip the Otter” — Saturday, 6pm, Community Hall. Tickets $4. Children under 7 must come with an adult.

Which child can watch the movie alone?
fresh.c: Children under 7 need an adult, so a 10-year-old can come alone.
fresh.j: Lights, camera, correct answer!

fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🏊 SWIMMING LESSONS!
Learn to swim with Coach Tan! Every Saturday, 9am. $60 for 4 lessons. Sign up by 15 March — only 20 places!

What should you do if you want to join?
fresh.c: The poster says to sign up by 15 March, and places are limited.
fresh.j: Dive in — you got it right!

fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🍓 HEALTHY EATING WEEK!
Eat a rainbow every day! Free fruit with every lunch set this week, while stocks last. Only at the school canteen.

When can you get free fruit?
o: Any time you ask for it
With a lunch set, while stocks last
fresh.c: The free fruit comes with a lunch set — and only while stocks last!
fresh.j: Eat a rainbow — and a correct answer!

fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🎪 SCHOOL FAIR!
Games, food and fun for the whole family! Saturday, 10am–3pm, School Field. Entry is free. Rides cost $2 per ride.

How much is entry to the fair?
fresh.c: Entry is free — only the rides cost $2 each.
fresh.j: Free entry, full marks!

retry.q:
Read this poster:

📚 BOOK SWAP!
Bring a book, take a book! Saturday, 10am–12pm, Library. Books must be in good condition. One book per person.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To ask people to clean the library
To ask people to swap books at the library
To teach people to write books
retry.c: The poster is about swapping books — bring one, take one!
retry.j: Swap a book, keep the knowledge!

retry.q:
Read this poster:

🚸 ROAD SAFETY!
Stop, look and listen before you cross. Always use the zebra crossing. Hold an adult’s hand.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To teach children how to cross the road safely
To ask children to build a zebra crossing
retry.c: The poster teaches the safe steps for crossing a road.
retry.j: Stop, look, listen — and answer correctly!

retry.q:
Read this poster:

🎵 MUSIC LESSONS!
Learn piano or guitar! Lessons every Wednesday, 4pm–5pm. $25 per lesson. First lesson free for new pupils!

How much is the first lesson for a new pupil?
retry.c: The first lesson is free for new pupils.

retry.q:
Read this notice:

🌳 PARK RULES
No littering. Keep dogs on a leash. Do not pick the flowers. Enjoy the park!

What must dog owners do?
o: Keep their dogs on a leash
retry.c: The rules say dogs must stay on a leash in the park.

retry.q:
Read this poster:

🎨 DRAWING CONTEST!
Draw your dream house! Open to all pupils. Entries must reach the Art Room by Friday, 3pm. Late entries will not be accepted.

What happens to late entries?
o: They will be returned on Monday
retry.c: The poster is clear: late entries will not be accepted.
retry.j: Right on time — and right on target!

retry.q:
Read this poster:

🍔 BURGER DAY!
Buy 1 burger, get 1 free! Only on Monday, 12pm–2pm. One free burger per person. Only at Burger King, Tampines Mall.

When is the burger offer?
retry.c: The offer is only on Monday between 12pm and 2pm.
retry.j: A tasty deal — and a tasty answer!

p4quest.q:
Read this poster:

🌳 TREE PLANTING DAY!
Help us plant 100 trees in our neighbourhood! Join us on Saturday, 14 June, 8am–12pm, at Bishan Park. Tools and gloves will be provided. Volunteers under 12 must come with a parent. Register online by 10 June!

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To sell trees at Bishan Park
To teach people about different trees
To ask people to water the park
To ask people to volunteer to plant trees
p4quest.c: The poster asks for volunteers to help plant trees.
p4quest.j: Plant a tree, grow a great answer!

p4quest.q:
Read this notice:

📢 LIBRARY CLOSURE NOTICE
The Tampines Library will be closed from 1 to 5 July for upgrading works. All borrowed books can be returned at any other library. We apologise for any inconvenience.

Why is the library closed?
p4quest.c: The notice says the library is closed for upgrading works.
p4quest.j: Closed for upgrades — open for correct answers!

p4quest.q:
Read this poster:

🚲 CYCLING SAFETY WEEK!
Ride safe, ride smart! Always wear a helmet. Use the cycling path, not the road. Check your brakes before every ride. Free helmet checks at the Community Centre, Saturday 9am–1pm.

What should you check before every ride?
p4quest.c: The poster says to check your brakes before every ride.

p4quest.q:
Read this poster:

🎭 DRAMA CLUB SHOW: “THE LION KING”!
Friday, 18 July, 7pm, School Hall. Tickets: Adults $8, Children $4. Children under 5 enter free. Doors open at 6.30pm. No late entry after 7.15pm.

How much is a ticket for a child?
p4quest.c: Children’s tickets cost $4 — only under-5s enter free.
p4quest.j: The show must go on — and so must your correct answers!

p4quest.q:
Read this poster:

🏖️ SENTOSA DAY OUT!
Family package: 2 adults + 2 children for $120! Includes island entry and one ride each. Offer valid till 31 August. Book online only. Not valid on public holidays.

When can you NOT use this offer?
p4quest.c: The small print says the offer is not valid on public holidays.
p4quest.j: Read the small print — you caught the trap!

p4warm.q:
Read this poster:

🩸 BLOOD DONATION DRIVE!
Give blood, save lives! Saturday, 9am–3pm, Community Club. Donors must be aged 18–60 and in good health. Bring your identity card.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To ask healthy adults to donate blood
To ask children to give blood

p4warm.q:
Read this notice:

💧 SAVE WATER!
Turn off the tap while brushing your teeth. A running tap wastes 6 litres of water every minute. Small steps save a lot!

What is the main purpose of this notice?
o: To ask people to drink more water
To ask people to save water
To teach people to brush teeth

p4warm.q:
Read this poster:

🧮 MATHS OLYMPIAD!
Are you a maths whizz? Take part in our Maths Olympiad! For Primary 4 to 6 pupils. Register with your maths teacher by 20 May.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To ask teachers to set maths questions
To ask Primary 4 to 6 pupils to join a maths contest

p4warm.q:
Read this poster:

🚌 SCHOOL BUS SERVICE
New bus routes start next term. Bus 3 leaves at 6.45am. Bus 5 leaves at 7.00am. Late pupils will not be picked up.

What time does Bus 3 leave?

Read this poster:

🎾 TENNIS COACHING!
Beginners welcome! Every Sunday, 10am–11am, Sports Centre. Rackets provided. $15 per lesson. First trial lesson free!

How much is each lesson?

Read this notice:

🗑️ BULKY ITEMS DISPOSAL
Residents may dispose of bulky items on the first Monday of each month. Place items at the bin centre by 9am. No renovation waste allowed.

When can residents dispose of bulky items?
o: On the first Monday of each month
On the first day of each month

p4warm.q:
Read this poster:

🎁 LUCKY DRAW!
Spend $50 in one receipt at FairPrice to win a bicycle! One entry per receipt. Draw on 1 September. Winners will be called.

How do you enter the lucky draw?
o: Spend $50 in total over the month

p4warm.q:
Read this poster:

🍕 PIZZA PROMOTION!
Large pizza at $20 (usual price $30)! Only for takeaway. Offer ends Sunday. Not valid with other promotions.

What is the catch in this offer?
o: It is only for small pizzas

p4fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🌏 EARTH DAY!
Switch off your lights for one hour, 8.30pm–9.30pm, on 22 April. Together, we can save the planet! Join millions around the world.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To ask people to switch off lights for Earth Hour
To teach people about the Earth
To ask people to stay up late
p4fresh.c: The poster asks everyone to switch off lights for one hour.

p4fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🚀 SCIENCE CENTRE HOLIDAY PROGRAMME!
Build your own robot! 2–5 June, 9am–12pm. For children aged 8–12. $120 per child, materials included. Limited to 30 children!

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To ask children to visit the Science Centre
To tell parents about a robot-building holiday programme
To sell robots at the Science Centre
To teach children to use computers
p4fresh.c: The poster tells parents about a holiday programme where children build robots.

p4fresh.q:
Read this poster:

📸 PHOTOGRAPHY CONTEST!
Theme: “My Neighbourhood”. Send your best photo by 30 November. Open to all ages. Top prize: a brand-new camera worth $500!

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To teach people to take photos
To ask people to visit the neighbourhood
To ask people to send photos for a contest
p4fresh.c: The poster invites people to enter a photography contest.
p4fresh.j: Picture perfect — just like your answer!

p4fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🎤 TALENT SHOW AUDITIONS!
Sing, dance, act — show us your talent! Auditions on Monday, 3pm, Music Room. Prepare a 2-minute act. Only 15 acts will be chosen for the show.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To sell tickets to a talent show
To teach pupils to sing and dance
To ask pupils to watch a show
To ask pupils to audition for a talent show
p4fresh.c: The poster asks pupils to prepare an act and audition.
p4fresh.j: Star quality — and a star answer!

p4fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🏃 RUN FOR CHARITY!
Join our 10km charity run on Sunday, 6am, at the Stadium. Registration fee: $20. All money goes to children’s homes. Finishers get a medal!

What do finishers get?
p4fresh.c: The poster says finishers get a medal.
p4fresh.j: You crossed the finish line — with the right answer!

p4fresh.q:
Read this notice:

🏫 SCHOOL EARLY DISMISSAL
School will end at 11am on Friday, 30 May, for Teachers’ Day. School buses will leave at 11.15am. Please arrange to pick up your child.

What time do school buses leave on 30 May?
p4fresh.c: The notice says buses leave at 11.15am.

p4fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🍿 CINEMA SPECIAL!
Watch any movie for $6 on Wednesdays! Tickets must be bought at the counter. Offer is for students only — show your student pass. Not valid on public holidays.

Who can enjoy the $6 ticket?
p4fresh.c: The offer is for students only, and you must show your student pass.

p4fresh.q:
Read this poster:

✈️ FAMILY HOLIDAY DEAL!
3 days, 2 nights in Kuala Lumpur — flights and hotel for a family of 4, only $999! Book by 15 December. Travel must be completed by 28 February.

What must you do by 15 December?
p4fresh.c: You must book by 15 December — travel can be later, by 28 February.
p4fresh.j: Booked it — the right answer, that is!

p4fresh.q:
Read this poster:

💻 FREE CODING WORKSHOP!
Learn to code your first game! Saturday, 2pm–4pm, Library. For ages 10–12. Free, but registration is needed. Only 25 places — first come, first served!

What should you do first if you want a place?
p4fresh.c: The workshop is free, but you must register — and places are limited.

p4fresh.q:
Read this poster:

🐢 TURTLE WATCH!
See baby turtles hatch! Guided tours nightly, 8pm–10pm, at Changi Beach. Tours run only from November to February. Bookings essential.

When do the turtle tours run?
p4fresh.c: The poster says tours run only from November to February.
p4fresh.j: Slow and steady — like a turtle, and like a great answer!

p4retry.q:
Read this poster:

🌻 VOLUNTEER WITH US!
Help at our food bank! Sort and pack food for families in need. Every Saturday, 10am–1pm. No experience needed. Students welcome!

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To ask families to donate money
To ask people to volunteer at a food bank
p4retry.c: The poster asks for volunteers to help at the food bank.

p4retry.q:
Read this poster:

🎻 ORCHESTRA CONCERT!
Enjoy an evening of classical music! Saturday, 7.30pm, Esplanade Concert Hall. Tickets from $20. Students get 50% off with a student pass.

What is the main purpose of this poster?
o: To teach people to play the violin
To ask people to join an orchestra
To tell people about an orchestra concert
p4retry.c: The poster tells people about the concert so they will buy tickets.

p4retry.q:
Read this notice:

🚧 ROAD WORKS AHEAD
Jalan Besar will be closed from 10pm to 5am, Monday to Friday, for road works. Please use an alternative route. We apologise for the inconvenience.

When is Jalan Besar closed?
p4retry.c: The notice says the road is closed from 10pm to 5am on weekdays.
p4retry.j: Detour avoided — straight to the right answer!

p4retry.q:
Read this poster:

🏸 BADMINTON CLINIC!
Learn badminton from a national coach! Sunday, 9am–11am, Sports Hall. For ages 9–13. Rackets provided. $10 per session.

What is provided at the clinic?
p4retry.c: The poster says rackets are provided.

p4retry.q:
Read this poster:

🛍️ MEGA SALE!
Up to 70% off everything! This weekend only. Members get an extra 10% off. Discount applies at the counter — prices on tags are before discount.

What do the prices on the tags show?
p4retry.c: The tags show prices before discount — the discount is taken at the counter.

questions.q: Lily was under the weather, so she stayed in bed. What does “under the weather” mean?
questions.c: “Under the weather” means feeling sick!
questions.j: Feel better soon — and well done!

questions.q: Join these two sentences: “The boy is tall. He plays basketball.”
o: The boy who is tall plays basketball.
The boy is tall he plays basketball.
The boy who is tall play basketball.
The tall boy plays basketball he is.
questions.c: “Who” joins the sentences — the tall boy plays basketball!
questions.j: Joined up — just like your answer!

questions.q: Which sentence is in the correct order?
questions.c: A good sentence starts with who did it — the cat chased the mouse!
questions.j: In perfect order — just like your answer!

questions.q: On Sunday, the Tan family went to the zoo. They saw lions, elephants and monkeys. Father took many photos. Where did the Tan family go on Sunday?
questions.c: The passage says they went to the zoo!
questions.j: To the zoo — and to the top of the class!

questions.q: First, Ana washed her hands. Then she helped her mother cook rice. After dinner, she washed the dishes. What did Ana do FIRST?
questions.c: “First” — Ana washed her hands before anything else!
questions.j: First things first — a first-class answer!

questions.q: The little boat bobbed gently on the waves. The word “bobbed” means ___.
questions.c: Bobbing means moving gently up and down on the water!
questions.j: Bobbing along — and bobbing up with the right answer!

questions.q: When Hana saw her lost puppy at the gate, she ran to it with tears in her eyes and hugged it tight. How did Hana feel?
questions.c: Tears and a tight hug — Hana was so happy her puppy was home!
questions.j: Happy tears — and a happy answer!

questions.q: Raj packed his bag, put on his raincoat and took an umbrella. He looked out of the window at the dark clouds. Why did Raj take an umbrella?
o: Because it was going to rain
questions.c: Dark clouds and a raincoat — rain was coming!
questions.j: Rain or shine — your answer is fine!

questions.q: The school library opens at 8am. Pupils can borrow two books at a time. Which sentence is TRUE?
Ali has a red bicycle. He rides it to school every day. The word “it” refers to ___.
It was raining cats and dogs, so we stayed indoors. What does “raining cats and dogs” mean?
Join these two sentences: “I like cats. I like dogs.”
o: I like cats I like dogs.

questions.q: Which of these sentences is in the right order?
o: We breakfast eat in the morning.
In the morning we breakfast eat.
Eat we breakfast in the morning.
We eat breakfast in the morning.

questions.q: Mei’s favourite colour is blue. She has a blue bag, a blue pencil case and blue shoes. What is Mei’s favourite colour?
Sam planted a seed. He watered it every day. Soon, a small plant grew. What happened LAST?
The brave fireman rushed into the smoky house. The word “brave” means ___.
Tom’s face turned red when the teacher praised him in front of the class. How did Tom feel?
Lily kept looking at the clock. Her bag was packed and she was wearing her shoes. What was Lily probably waiting for?
Cats sleep a lot. A cat can sleep for 15 hours a day! Which sentence is FALSE?
o: A cat can sleep 15 hours a day.
questions.c: Cats sleep a lot — they do not “never sleep”!
questions.j: Cat nap? More like a cat-tastic answer!

questions.q: The children built a sandcastle. It was very big. Then the waves washed it away. The word “it” in “It was very big” refers to ___.
questions.c: “It” means the sandcastle — it was very big!
questions.j: A big sandcastle — and a big correct answer!

questions.q: The test was a piece of cake for Sara. What does “a piece of cake” mean?
questions.c: “A piece of cake” means very easy!
questions.j: Easy as pie — or should I say, cake!

questions.q: Join these two sentences: “The soup was hot. We waited for it to cool.”
o: The soup was hot, so we waited for it to cool.
The soup was hot we waited for it to cool.
The soup was hot but we waited for it to cool.
The soup was hot, we waited for it to cool it.
questions.c: “So” joins them — hot soup, so we waited!
questions.j: Hot soup, cool answer!

questions.q: Which sentence has all its words in the right order?
o: The sweet song the bird sang.
The bird sang a sweet song.
The bird a sweet song sang.
Sang the bird a sweet song.
questions.c: A good sentence starts with who did it — the bird sang!
questions.j: Sweet song, sweet answer!

questions.q: The old man sells ice cream near the school. He sells chocolate, strawberry and mango flavours. What does the old man sell?
questions.c: The passage says he sells ice cream!
questions.j: Three scoops of correct!

questions.q: First, mix the flour and sugar. Next, add two eggs. Then bake the cake for 30 minutes. What do you do AFTER adding the eggs?
questions.c: After the eggs, it is time to bake!
questions.j: Bake it till you make it!

questions.q: The giant waves crashed against the rocks. The word “giant” means ___.
questions.c: Giant means very big — giant waves!
questions.j: A giant answer!

questions.q: When the lights went out during the storm, Tim hid under his blanket and held his teddy bear tight. How did Tim feel?
questions.c: Hiding under a blanket with a teddy — Tim was scared!
questions.j: Scaredy-cat? No — a brave answer!

questions.q: Mei put on her swimsuit, grabbed her towel and ran to the pool. What was Mei going to do?
questions.c: Swimsuit, towel and pool — Mei was going swimming!
questions.j: Dive in — you got it right!

questions.q: Dogs are good pets. They need food, water and exercise every day. Which sentence is TRUE?
questions.c: The passage says dogs need food, water and exercise!
questions.j: Good dogs — and a good answer!

questions.q: Emma gave her friend a gift. She was very happy to receive it. The word “she” in “She was very happy” refers to ___.
questions.c: The friend received the gift — she was happy!
questions.j: A gift of a correct answer!

questions.q: Don’t spill the beans about the surprise party! What does “spill the beans” mean?
questions.c: “Spill the beans” means to tell a secret!
questions.j: Secret’s safe with you — and so is this answer!

questions.q: The River Hongbao is a big festival in Singapore. Every year, thousands of people visit to see the lanterns and enjoy the performances. The festival lasts for about two weeks. Which sentence is TRUE?
o: Only a few people visit the festival.
The festival is held in Malaysia.
The festival lasts about two weeks.
questions.c: The passage says the festival lasts about two weeks!
questions.j: Two weeks of lanterns — and one bright answer!

questions.q: Penguins cannot fly, but they are excellent swimmers. They use their wings like flippers to move through the water. Most penguins live in the cold south. Which sentence is FALSE?
o: Penguins live mostly in the cold south.
Penguins use their wings to swim.
questions.c: Penguins cannot fly — that is the false part!
questions.j: Penguins can’t fly — but your answer can!

questions.q: The children found an old map in the attic. It showed the way to a hidden treasure. They decided to follow it the next day. The word “it” in “They decided to follow it” refers to ___.
questions.c: “It” means the map — they followed the map!
questions.j: X marks the spot — and the right answer!

questions.q: Mrs Lee planted roses and tulips in her garden. She watered them every morning. Soon, they bloomed beautifully. The word “them” refers to ___.
questions.c: “Them” means the roses and tulips — she watered them!
questions.j: Blooming lovely — just like your answer!

questions.q: After months of practice, Bala finally broke the ice with his new classmates. What does “broke the ice” mean?
o: Started to feel comfortable with new people
questions.c: “Broke the ice” means the awkward feeling melted away!
questions.j: Ice broken — and the answer is warm!

questions.q: The exam was tough, but Priya decided to hit the books every evening. What does “hit the books” mean?
questions.c: “Hit the books” means to start studying hard!
questions.j: Hit the books — and hit the bullseye!

questions.q: Join these two sentences: “The book is interesting. It is about space.”
o: The book, which is about space, is interesting.
The book is interesting it is about space.
The book which is about space is interesting it.
The interesting book is about space it is.
questions.c: “Which” joins them neatly — the book about space is interesting!
questions.j: Out of this world — a stellar answer!

questions.q: Which of these sentences is put together correctly?
questions.c: “Yesterday” first, then who did what — perfect order!
questions.j: Yesterday’s trip, today’s correct answer!

questions.q: The National Gallery is in the Civic District. It houses the largest collection of Singapore art in the world. Visitors can see paintings, sculptures and photographs. What can visitors see at the National Gallery?
questions.c: The passage lists paintings, sculptures and photographs!
questions.j: A gallery of great answers!

questions.q: First, the caterpillar eats lots of leaves. Then it wraps itself in a cocoon. Finally, it comes out as a butterfly. What happens AFTER the caterpillar wraps itself in a cocoon?
o: It comes out as a butterfly.
questions.c: After the cocoon comes the butterfly!
questions.j: From caterpillar to butterfly — and to a beautiful answer!

questions.q: The ancient temple stood on the hill for hundreds of years. The word “ancient” means ___.
questions.c: Ancient means very, very old!
questions.j: Ancient temple, timeless answer!

questions.q: When Sara’s name was called as the winner, her hands shook and her heart beat fast. She could not believe her ears. How did Sara feel?
questions.c: Shaking hands and a fast heart — excited and nervous!
questions.j: Winner, winner — correct answer for dinner!

questions.q: Tom looked at the empty fridge, sighed, and picked up his wallet and shopping list. What was Tom probably going to do?
questions.c: Empty fridge plus wallet and list — Tom is going shopping!
questions.j: Shopping list checked — answer checked!

questions.q: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west. It gives us light and heat. Which sentence is TRUE?
o: The sun rises in the west.
The sun sets in the east.
The sun rises in the east.

questions.q: Jia bought a new kite. She flew it at the beach. It soared high into the sky. The word “it” in “It soared high” refers to ___.
I was on cloud nine when I won the prize. What does “on cloud nine” mean?
Join these two sentences: “The rain stopped. We went out to play.”
o: The rain stopped but we went out to play.
The rain stopped, we went out to play it.
The rain stopped, so we went out to play.
The rain stopped we went out to play.

questions.q: Which sentence is written correctly, with its words in the right order?
o: Reading in the library are the pupils.
The library are the pupils reading in.
Pupils the library in are reading.
The pupils are reading in the library.

questions.q: The Merlion is a famous symbol of Singapore. It has the head of a lion and the body of a fish. What does the Merlion look like?
o: A lion’s head and a fish’s body
A fish’s head and a lion’s body

questions.q: To make a sandwich, first spread butter on the bread. Then add cheese and ham. Finally, put the other slice on top. What is the FIRST step?
o: Put the other slice on top

questions.q: The hikers were weary after the long climb. The word “weary” means ___.
Ben’s shoulders drooped and he stared at the floor after losing the match. How did Ben feel?
Aisha packed an umbrella, a raincoat and a pair of boots. What kind of weather was Aisha expecting?
Bees help flowers by carrying pollen from one flower to another. Without bees, many plants could not make seeds. Which sentence is FALSE?
questions.c: Bees help flowers — they do not hurt them!
questions.j: Busy bees — and a busy brain!

questions.q: The orchestra played beautifully. The audience clapped loudly for them. The word “them” refers to ___.
questions.c: “Them” means the orchestra — the audience clapped for them!
questions.j: Encore! Another correct answer!

questions.q: Don’t judge a book by its cover. What does this saying mean?
o: Do not buy books with covers
Do not judge something only by how it looks
questions.c: A plain cover can hide a wonderful story!
questions.j: Judge this answer — it’s a good one!

questions.q: Join these two sentences: “She was ill. She stayed at home.”
o: She was ill, so she stayed at home.
She was ill she stayed at home.
She was ill but she stayed at home.
She was ill, she stayed at home it.
questions.c: “So” joins them — ill, so she stayed home!
questions.j: Get well soon — and well done!

questions.q: Which of these sentences has the words in the correct order?
o: Every Sunday my mother cookies delicious bakes.
My mother bakes delicious cookies every Sunday.
My mother delicious cookies bakes every Sunday.
Bakes my mother delicious cookies every Sunday.
questions.c: Who does what, then when — perfect order!
questions.j: Fresh from the oven — and fresh from the top!

questions.q: The Singapore Flyer is a giant observation wheel. From the top, you can see the whole city and even parts of Malaysia and Indonesia. What can you see from the top of the Singapore Flyer?
o: The whole city and parts of nearby countries
questions.c: The passage says you can see the city and parts of Malaysia and Indonesia!
questions.j: What a view — and what an answer!

questions.q: A seed needs water, sunlight and air to grow. First it sprouts, then it grows leaves, and finally it flowers. What happens FIRST when a seed grows?
questions.c: “First it sprouts” — sprouting comes first!
questions.j: First things first — a sprouting good answer!

questions.q: The treasure map was fragile and tore easily. The word “fragile” means ___.
questions.c: Fragile means it breaks easily — handle with care!
questions.j: Handle with care — and handle this answer with pride!

questions.q: When the teacher announced a surprise test, the class groaned and put their heads on their desks. How did the class feel?
questions.c: Groans and heads on desks — nobody was happy about the test!
questions.j: A surprise test? Not a surprise that you got it right!

questions.q: The streets were wet, the sky was grey, and people were holding umbrellas. What had probably just happened?
questions.c: Wet streets and umbrellas — it had just rained!
questions.j: Rain, rain — go away, come again with another right answer!

questions.q: The moon shines at night, but it does not make its own light. It reflects light from the sun. Which sentence is TRUE?
o: The moon makes its own light.
The moon shines in the daytime.
The moon reflects light from the sun.
questions.c: The moon borrows light from the sun!
questions.j: To the moon and back — with a right answer!

questions.q: The farmer fed the chickens. Then he collected their eggs. The word “their” refers to ___.
questions.c: “Their eggs” — the eggs belong to the chickens!
questions.j: Fresh eggs — and a fresh correct answer!

questions.q: It’s raining cats and dogs outside! What does this mean?
questions.c: “Cats and dogs” means very heavy rain!
questions.j: Cats, dogs and correct answers — all falling from the sky!
